routes.component: Round registration, component ports and execution plan
routes.input: Role-neutral parent/model and frozen data-plane bindings
routes.output: GenericRoundManifest / BindingRegistry / ExecutionPlan
routes.boundary: Existing control contracts are reused; no model/environment execution is inferred from contract existence.

routes.input: ALFWorld TRAIN_UPDATE, TRAIN_SELECT, TRAIN_AUDIT manifest identities
routes.output: Train-only stage access decisions; disjoint task universe
routes.boundary: No valid_seen/valid_unseen or old pilot semantic data in the adaptive loop.

routes.component: Policy inference interface and task collection
routes.input: Frozen parent policy, complete menu, RAW prompt, I1 request schema, seeds and dual budgets
routes.output: Environment outcomes plus exact policy-call evidence
routes.boundary: Strict parser and exact menu membership retained. I1 affects generation; it is not unconstrained RAW generation.

routes.input: Registered gamefile / environment runtime; policy output
routes.output: Public transitions; no-clobber attempt bundle, lock and attempt receipts
routes.boundary: Environment failures and scientific task failures remain distinct.

routes.input: Frozen train-side episode and full traces
routes.output: Evidence Pack / mechanical event facts / current clean policy binding
routes.boundary: Facts reconstructed by code; hypotheses do not overwrite environmental evidence.

routes.component: Adaptive analysis budget and source input materialization
routes.input: Round resource cap + eligible complete failure universe
routes.output: Deterministic local input registry and count
routes.boundary: Counts derived from frozen budget and evidence; no Analyzer-controlled denominator.

routes.input: Same authorized train episode; Memory OFF
routes.output: Local error instances / principal proposal or abstention
routes.boundary: No causal Benefit authority; complete trace boundaries preserved.

routes.input: Exact accepted A1 bytes + mechanical grouping; optional historical Memory pack
routes.output: Source-conditioned grouped hypotheses and candidate repairs
routes.boundary: A2 and A3 differ only by registered Memory exposure; K and member lineage retained.

routes.component: Component, policy profile and independent cross-check / C-P-X
routes.input: Group hypotheses / current evidence / admissible historical evidence
routes.output: Component attribution; deterministic policy profile; challenge results
routes.boundary: Challenge may reject/downgrade; cannot rewrite environment truth or secretly replace repairs.

routes.input: Typed actor manifest + stage projection + fixed output schema
routes.output: Exact requests/responses / validated result / censored attempt ledger
routes.boundary: Original P2 transport adapter reused. No hidden conversation state or retry after ambiguous send.

routes.component: Procedural Failure Experience and role-specific retrieval
routes.input: Clean train experience, Analyzer hypotheses, frozen effect status
routes.output: Governed Memory records; Policy/Analyzer/Researcher projections
routes.boundary: Memory is evidence storage and retrieval, not a separate semantic reasoning model.

routes.input: Prior immutable snapshot + current round shadow events and verified effects
routes.output: Next-round promotion/quarantine decisions and immutable snapshot
routes.boundary: No same-round readback. Current T2 diagnostic result alone does not promote Memory content.

routes.input: Analyzer results, current scientific evidence, permitted Memory and cost views
routes.output: Round Evidence Package / Research Planner common input
routes.boundary: SELECT reaches Planner only as aggregate; sealed benchmarks never reach adaptive decisions.

routes.input: Shared blind evidence cutoff + candidate universe
routes.output: Single principal change; selected/rejected/deferred portfolio; verification budget
routes.boundary: Human PRE is current reference, not future permanent controller. Strong shadow cannot retroactively alter it.

routes.input: Exact source state/prefix/menu/policy; frozen repair; paired seeds
routes.output: Branch evidence and terminal Benefit/Harm/Neutral/Uncertain labels
routes.boundary: No Analyzer/Planner self-granted causal authority; all branch actions consume original budgets.

routes.input: Frozen F0/F1 results + original PRE decisions
routes.output: Selected training arm / dataset semantics / loss and resource plan
routes.boundary: Current T2 remains unverified-repair diagnostic. Neutral does not become Benefit.

routes.input: Approved training plan + exact source/action evidence
routes.output: Trainer-native input IDs, target labels and lineage checks
routes.boundary: No silent truncation; no benchmark data; use existing renderer and training contracts.

routes.component: Clean initialization, training execution and receipts
routes.input: Clean parent + fixed final-only training plan
routes.output: T2 adapter, formal training manifest, candidate handoff
routes.boundary: Current final checkpoint only; no post-evaluation seed selection or retraining.

routes.component: SELECT preflight and frozen scientific protocol
routes.input: Candidate handoff + disjoint TRAIN_SELECT pool
routes.output: 355-task seed-major T0/T2 grid; fixed protocol and fixed head
routes.boundary: No reselection, budget expansion, or changed I1 request semantics after results.

routes.component: Typed SELECT binding and server readiness
routes.input: Frozen protocol + exact model/adapter/runtime
routes.output: Typed policy/server/condition/schedule manifests; two route probes
routes.boundary: Readiness is non-scientific; static base + single LoRA, no dynamic updates.

routes.input: Original authorization + completed canonical prefix + exact schedules
routes.output: Shard-local attempt/receipt chains and deterministic canonical consolidation
routes.boundary: One GPU per shard; each pair remains T0 then T2; no duplicate scientific cells. This source is immutable while job 156834 runs.

routes.component: Independent one-GPU array migration and outcome-blind completion follow
routes.input: Original authorization + verified canonical prefix + never-started pending job
routes.output: Four registered shard jobs, original canonical completion and original Stage4E closeout
routes.boundary: No new evaluator; cancel only an owned PENDING job; all array elements and native status hashes required; no failed-job rerun

routes.input: Parent job completed 0:0 plus full 3550 completion artifact
routes.output: Reloaded attempts / native I1 identity-chain audit / complete denominator
routes.boundary: Never read partial success while waiting; missing scientific outcome is not a failure.

routes.input: Fully audited canonical T0/T2 receipt sets
routes.output: Per-task mean-over-seeds difference, equal task weighting; registered secondary metrics
routes.boundary: Reuse legacy numeric aggregator only, never old 17-task polluted pilot closeout. No post-hoc significance/equivalence threshold.

routes.input: Audited aggregate + frozen diagnostic non-promotion rule
routes.output: Native PromotionDecision ROLLBACK/retain-parent; NextRoundCreation record
routes.boundary: Positive measured delta does not override promotion_eligible=false. Next-round creation is not scientific execution authorization.

routes.component: Human / Strong / Local role traces and localization data
routes.input: Frozen clean role traces with accepted/revised/rejected lineage
routes.output: RoleTraceRecord / reference demonstrations / eligible local supervision
routes.boundary: No current round answer leak or old contaminated pilot reuse. Runtime role equivalence must be verified, not asserted.

routes.input: Measured takeover evidence, fresh round budget and actor/model bindings
routes.output: Existing deterministic eligibility and role authority plan
routes.boundary: No invented missing metrics, no routine human decision fallback. Insufficient evidence yields machine HOLD; full autonomous execution not yet claimed.

routes.input: Fixed compared policies and shared benchmark protocol
routes.output: Sealed standard benchmark product / controlled final unsealing
routes.boundary: Not an adaptive-loop data source; benchmark result values remain unread by this delivery.

routes.component: Isolated source consolidation and verified Git publication
routes.input: Fixed native Git history + explicit latest execution wrappers + audit-only adapters
routes.output: Complete code-chain docs/AST index + FF-only atomic branch/main update
routes.boundary: No force push, no active worktree changes, no raw SELECT/benchmark trajectories or weights uploaded.
